change: Replace the ScanSum two-slot FIFO with a one-slot replacement-capable FIFO.
changeScope: Exactly one FIFO constructor; arithmetic, state recurrence, metadata, order, rules, interfaces and lane counts unchanged.

typecheck.scope: Package compilation/typechecking; module elaboration, scheduling and end-to-end behavior are verified separately by the full CI flow.

protocolReview.producer: process5 is the only sumQ producer and enqueues only the final partial for each channel.
protocolReview.consumer: process5_2 is the only sumQ consumer and atomically transfers to outputPartsQ.
protocolReview.registeredData: FIFOL1 EMPTY_N depends on its occupancy register; no empty bypass. Data is registered on enqueue and remains stable until dequeue or replacement.
protocolReview.readyPath: FIFOL1 FULL_N = !occupied || DEQ. The added replacement-ready edge ends at outputPartsQ, an ordinary mkFIFO1 with registered occupancy. There is no feedback to process5_2 from process5.
protocolReview.backpressure: A full sumQ with blocked outputPartsQ blocks its producer. When outputPartsQ accepts, sumQ can dequeue and enqueue in one cycle, preserving one accepted transfer per cycle at this boundary.
protocolReview.orderAndState: The final partial and its channel/direct metadata remain atomic. partialR update and all recurrent state writes are unchanged. Ordered final-channel collection remains the only token completion event.
protocolReview.capacity: Queue capacity reduces from two to one. It changes transient buffering and may change cycle counts under stalls; it does not change accepted data values or order.
protocolReview.reset: Occupancy clears on reset; no new control or data registers outside the FIFO.

timingIntent: Remove the two-slot head-selection mux from the measured Scan sumQ.data0 data path; actual clock closure requires fresh source-matched place and route.
